method: Independent complete git-archive v2.6.8/current modules, unchanged v255 2/6-season fixtures, one isolated process per workflow, alternating before/after sample order. Transpilation, deterministic fixture creation/cloning, hashing and explicit GC excluded from timings. CPU engine only. Cold requests the entire catalog or a single player goals/combination attack-pair starts leaderboard. Warm/revisit reuse saved array identity; metric switches to assists/minutes; player team selection measures a display projection of full official ranks on both versions, preserving intentional v2.6.9 semantics for exact comparisons; position selects ST/SS. Edit removes the first goal in the Season 1 League opener with immutable match replacement. All returned rows, ranks, strings and catalog order are SHA-256 compared, including complete unfiltered catalogs.
